skills.name: expose-localhost
skills.description: Expose a local service to the public internet using ngrok. Starts a tunnel, optionally adds OAuth or WAF via Traffic Policy. Handles HTTP services and raw TCP (SSH, RDP, databases). Use when asked to expose, tunnel, share, or make a local service publicly accessible, or to reach a machine that has no public IP. Also covers sharing work-in-progress with a specific person and the dev-server quirks that break a shared preview.
headings: local sshd on port 22, reached through the address above
skills.description_zh: 通过 ngrok 隧道向公网开放本地 HTTP 或 TCP 服务，可用 Traffic Policy 添加 OAuth 或 WAF；支持共享开发预览、SSH/RDP/数据库及访问无公网 IP 设备。

skills.name: ngrok-engine
skills.description: Reference for ngrok's traffic model - what an endpoint is and what happens to traffic at the edge. Covers endpoint types (agent, cloud, internal), bindings and protocols (HTTP, TLS, TCP), and Traffic Policy - the YAML rule language of phases, CEL expressions, and actions, with a generated catalog of all 26 actions. Other ngrok skills point here to decide what to build, then to ngrok-surfaces to apply it. Not a standalone task - load when another skill references it.
headings: The ngrok engine: endpoints and Traffic Policy
skills.description_zh: 作为 ngrok 参考说明端点及边缘流量模型，涵盖 agent、cloud、internal 端点、HTTP/TLS/TCP 绑定和由阶段、CEL 表达式及动作组成的 Traffic Policy，原说明含 26 项动作目录；供其他技能引用。

skills.name: ngrok-setup
skills.description: Get authenticated and ready to use ngrok on whatever surface the task needs - agent CLI, an SDK, or infrastructure-as-code. Detects what is already installed, walks the one-time authtoken step, and routes to the right surface. Use before other ngrok tasks, or whenever an ngrok command fails with an authentication or configuration error. Use when the user says "set up ngrok", "install ngrok", "add my authtoken", "ngrok isn't authenticated", or "getting an auth error from ngrok".
headings: 3. Make sure the tool is present
skills.description_zh: 检测并配置 ngrok 的 CLI、SDK 或基础设施代码使用环境，完成一次性 authtoken 认证并路由到对应方式，排查认证和配置错误。

skills.name: ngrok-surfaces
skills.description: How to apply an ngrok endpoint and Traffic Policy on whichever surface the user is actually working in - the agent CLI and ngrok.yml, the ngrok SDKs (Go, JavaScript, Python, Rust), the REST API at api.ngrok.com, the Terraform provider, and the Kubernetes Operator. Routes from signals in the user's project to the right surface, then to that surface's reference file. Other ngrok skills point here once they know what to build. Not a standalone task - load when another skill references it.
headings: Applying ngrok on the user's surface
The axis that actually separates them
skills.description_zh: 按用户项目选择 ngrok CLI/ngrok.yml、Go/JavaScript/Python/Rust SDK、REST API、Terraform 或 Kubernetes Operator，应用端点和 Traffic Policy；作为其他技能的实施参考。

skills.name: provision-sandbox-access
skills.description: Give every sandbox, container, device, or tenant its own isolated ngrok endpoint, provisioned programmatically at runtime from a controlplane. Covers the per-workload resource set - service user, reserved address or domain, ACL-scoped authtoken, cloud endpoint forwarding to a private internal endpoint - plus the agent config that runs inside the workload, and teardown. Use when the user is building a platform that spins up isolated environments.
headings: 3. Mint a credential that can do exactly one thing
5. Configure the agent inside the workload
skills.description_zh: 为动态创建隔离环境的平台配置每个沙箱、容器、设备或租户独立的 ngrok 端点，涵盖服务用户、保留地址域名、ACL 限定 authtoken、cloud 到私有 internal 转发、工作负载配置及销毁。

skills.name: receive-webhooks
skills.description: Receive and verify inbound webhooks from providers like Stripe, GitHub, Twilio, Slack, or Shopify and deliver them to a local or private service without exposing that service to the public internet. Verify signatures at the edge with no app code; route third-party callbacks to a service behind a firewall, including regulated (HIPAA/PCI) environments or a centralized webhook gateway shared across teams. Use when the user needs to receive, test, or debug webhooks locally, wants signature verification without writing it, or must route callbacks to a private service.
skills.description_zh: 在边缘验证 Stripe、GitHub、Twilio、Slack 或 Shopify 等 webhook 签名，将回调转发给本地或防火墙后的私有服务，无需公开后端或编写验证代码；支持集中网关与受监管网络场景。

skills.name: run-mcp-gateway
skills.description: Expose an in-development MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for remote testing against AI model providers like Claude and OpenAI, with per-provider authentication and traffic inspection. Puts a cloud endpoint in front of your local MCP server, authenticates each provider with its own bearer [已隐藏] via Vaults, and forwards to your server kept off the public internet. Use when the user is building or testing an MCP server and needs a remote AI client to reach it. Use when the user says "test my MCP server", "expose my MCP server to Claude", "connect my MCP server to OpenAI", or "front door for my MCP server".
skills.description_zh: 为开发中的 MCP server 设置 ngrok cloud 入口，按模型厂商分别认证并检查流量，转发到私有本地服务供远程 AI 客户端测试；原说明的 bearer 凭据部分已隐藏，由 Vaults 管理。

skills.name: secure-endpoint
skills.description: Put authentication, rate limiting, IP restrictions, header rules, or a custom response in front of an ngrok endpoint using a Traffic Policy, without changing application code. Covers requiring login (OAuth/OIDC), locking to specific IPs, blocking or denying requests, returning a maintenance page or custom response, and injecting or stripping headers. Use when the user wants to protect, gate, throttle, or add an API-gateway layer to an endpoint. Use when the user says "add auth to my ngrok URL", "require Google login", "rate limit my endpoint", "restrict by IP", "block a path", or "put up a maintenance page".
skills.description_zh: 通过 ngrok Traffic Policy 为端点添加 OAuth/OIDC、限流、IP 限制、请求阻断、维护页、自定义响应及 header 注入删除，无需修改应用代码。

skills.name: troubleshoot-ngrok
skills.description: Diagnose and fix common ngrok errors and connection problems - offline endpoints (ERR_NGROK_3200), agent authentication and connection failures, upstream/tunnel connection refused, and Traffic Policy errors. Reads the error code and explains the specific cause and fix. Use when an ngrok URL returns an error, a tunnel won't come up, or the agent reports a connection problem. Use when the user says "ngrok says endpoint offline", "ERR_NGROK_3200", "my tunnel isn't working", "why is my ngrok URL down", or pastes an ngrok error code.
skills.description_zh: 依据 ngrok 错误码诊断离线端点、认证连接失败、上游或隧道拒绝连接及 Traffic Policy 错误，解释具体原因和修复方法。
